about.title: About
about.subtitle: FinTechLab SPbU studies the relationship between human behavior, financial environments, digital systems, and protection.
about.body: Founded in 2025 at Saint Petersburg State University, the Laboratory of Modern Financial Technologies builds a scientific and applied base against behavioral vulnerabilities in modern financial threats. Work integrates behavioral economics, neuroscience, digital victimology, and financial-security practice — moving from experiment to technology, education, and regulatory insight.

decisionNetwork.title: THE DECISION NETWORK
decisionNetwork.heading: From stimulus to financial action.
decisionNetwork.supporting: A live map of how a financial choice forms — from the first cue to the irreversible click.
stageCopy: An external cue enters the field — message, alert, offer, authority signal.
Attention locks; meaning is assigned faster than verification can catch up.
Cognitive shortcuts tilt the frame — trust, loss, urgency, social proof.
Time and consequence compress the option space until pause feels costly.
A choice crystallizes under incomplete information and affective load.
Behavior becomes irreversible: transfer, disclosure, compliance, silence.
